highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 integrates Skia m158 fixes for GPU failures, image filtering and glyph rendering.
highlights_body: The collected native update preserves managed APIs, generated bindings and dependency versions.

bullets.detail: Propagates low-level draw and upload failures and abandons the context when recovery is unsafe. Failed promise-image fulfillment drops the flush's work but remains nonfatal, leaving the context usable.

Rejects oversized multisample attachments on affected Imagination GL, ANGLE and Vulkan devices. Ganesh and Graphite deliberately abandon Vulkan descriptor pools after affected out-of-memory errors rather than destroy them unsafely; Graphite rejects further allocations through a null pool handle.

Ganesh prevents unwritten scratch texels from entering filtered images through mipmaps and clips destination reads to their bounds. Graphite resets depth after full-overwrite draws to preserve painter order.
Corrects LCD16 bitmap bounds conversion and cropping when font scalers return different bounds between glyph loads. Bitmap validation and outline-translation checks also guard image buffer bounds.
Checks buffer alignment, padding and element-size arithmetic, rejects invalid sizes, allows CPU buffer allocation to fail safely, and caps block and vertex-chunk allocations.
